editorial:
Imagine being a regular electrician in a quiet Kazakh town where every day feels exactly the same. That is exactly how Bolekbay lives until a freak accident changes everything. While working on the job, he gets hit by lightning and wakes up with a wild new ability. He becomes a human magnet who can move metal things just by thinking about them. It is a funny and strange setup that turns a boring life into a chaotic adventure. You will quickly find yourself rooting for Bolekbay as he tries to figure out how to use his powers without making a total mess of his life.

The acting is great and the movie keeps a steady pace that never feels slow. You will love the funny moments when his powers go wrong, though some of the action scenes feel a bit simple. It is a perfect pick if you want something lighthearted and unique. It is the kind of flick that works great on a big screen with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, Bolekbay realizes that his powers are not just for show or making money. He uses his magnetic abilities to stop a major accident that would have hurt people in his town. After saving the day, he learns to balance his normal life with his secret gift. He finds peace with who he is and decides to use his power to help others quietly, ending the movie on a happy and hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and light comedy.
